note: Both sets make the same core table-reading errors: they misattribute spectrometer-section values to the camera rows (Visible FOV 1.9" and IR FOV 3.8" are spectrometer FOVs, not camera FOVs; 2×2 LMAPD and 2,048-pixel array width belong to the IR spectrometer, not the IR Guide camera), and both mislabel spectrometer resolution 7/40 as a spectrometer 'count'. Set A additionally repeats two claims (UV detector 1×1 and CCD201 listed twice) and has a second bogus 'count' claim (40), while Set B adds a wrong Visible camera array width of 4,096. Set B covers more distinct correct facts (UV FOV 10.2", UV spectrometer Slit/grism, IR science-band separation 69,000 km, IWA 108 mas, IR guide band 0.3–0.45 µm, telescope resolution 21 mas for UV and Visible, Visible wavelength band) with no duplicates, whereas A's unique correct coverage is narrower despite similar totals.
